entities.summary: Catherine Day is a former European civil servant from Ireland. Appointed in November 2005 as Secretary-General of the European Commission, she served two terms with President Jose Manuel Barroso and continued with his successor, Mr Jean-Claude Juncker until she retired in September 2015. She was the first woman to hold the post of Secretary General of the European Commission. Catherine Day was a performers & entertainers from Dublin (b. 1954-06-16, Dublin). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
